# Architecture and scenario evidence ledger

**Generated by** `scripts/gen-architecture-evidence-ledger.js` from
`data/arch-support/<minor>.json` and `data/scenario-support/<minor>.json`.
Do not hand-edit — change the data and regenerate, so the ledger cannot drift away
from what the validators enforce. `npm run check:evidence-ledger` fails if it is stale.

Every URL below was fetched and parsed locally (HTTP 200). Summarising fetchers were
deliberately not used: an earlier pass in this project produced a fabricated support
table that way, so all claims here come from literal page text.

Precedence rules for conflicting sources: [`EVIDENCE_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE.md`](./EVIDENCE_SOURCE_PRECEDENCE.md).

## 2. Architecture cells — upstream vs Architect

`upstreamSupport` is what Red Hat documents. `offered` is what Architect exposes.
They are allowed to differ; a narrowing requires an explicit `oaaScopeDecision`.
